name: @ophis/compat-api
description: Ophis sync-quote compat surface (Cloudflare Worker). Accepts the Odos v3 request shape (PathRequestV3 field names, single token in/out), answers with the QuoteResponse field surface plus a namespaced ophis block carrying an unsigned CoW order draft, the EIP-712 signing envelope, and explicit async-settlement semantics. Holds no keys; quote/build/relay only.
